title: A model that fits the mission
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: Does the way you earn fit what you say you are for?

I said it is the first time the person is grabbing a company that he had no part in building. It is like remodelling a house, not building one from scratch. He is going outside his comfort zone into a company whose process and data he doesn't understand.
Does he have the skill set intellectually, academically, to build it into a powerhouse? I said he is very enthusiastic to follow the learning curve of what he will do with the company.
A student said that there are paid membership tiers at three prices: it is how they are siphoning out valid accounts. I said: I thought it was straight advertising.

I said the person bought the platform wanting an objective news source. We have learned in the past, with a famous magazine and newspaper companies, that advertising can contaminate objective journalism. That is a conflict for him philosophically: advertisers kind of skewing the news.
So I think he is going to look for other revenue models that are not advertising, I said. That will be very interesting. It is my personal opinion.

Will he develop a news outlet where the advertising money will not contaminate the integrity of the journalism? That is the philosophical question, I said. It is like being in the stands and watching a person on a racetrack that has never been run before.
A student said: advertising runs everything. I said: we are living in very exciting times to watch him and see how he evolves it.
What is your business model, and what would it do to your mission?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write how you earn your money.
Write the mission you say you serve.
Write one other way to earn that would fit the mission better.
Write what you would never accept money from.

check.q: What did I say buying an existing company is like?
choices: Remodelling a house, not building one from scratch

check.q: What did I say can contaminate objective journalism?
What did I say the philosophical question is?
choices: Whether a news outlet can avoid the contamination of the journalism's integrity by advertising money

recap: Make sure your revenue model fits your mission. Know what money could skew your integrity.
